name: Tetsuro
source:
The protagonist of this story. A host working to become the number one host in the host club "Ganesha". Before he met Asuka, he was a cruel person who would resort to underhanded methods to brainwashing prostitutes for money.

[Translated from [url=https://enoshima210.work/2022/07/08/kagotori/]Official Site[/url]]
